# Paint-Techs LLC

> Licensed and insured painting contractor serving Jacksonville, FL and Northeast Florida (Duval, St. Johns, Clay, and Nassau counties). 5.0-star rating across 52 verified Google reviews. Free, on-site, written estimates daily 8 AM to 10 PM.

Paint-Techs LLC provides interior painting, exterior painting, kitchen cabinet refinishing, pool deck painting and staining, and commercial painting for homeowners and businesses across Northeast Florida. Call (904) 762-7062 for a free quote.

For expanded page content, see [llms-full.txt](https://www.paint-techs.com/llms-full.txt). For a machine-readable summary, see [ai-context.json](https://www.paint-techs.com/ai-context.json). A human-readable version of this page is at [/ai](https://www.paint-techs.com/ai).

## Services

- [Interior Painting](https://www.paint-techs.com/interior-painting): Wall, ceiling, trim, and door painting.
- [Exterior Painting](https://www.paint-techs.com/exterior-painting): Full house repaints and trim refreshes with Florida-formulated, UV- and humidity-resistant coatings.
- [Cabinet Painting](https://www.paint-techs.com/cabinet-painting): Factory-grade kitchen cabinet refinishing, sprayed on-site.
- [Pool Deck Painting & Staining](https://www.paint-techs.com/pool-deck-painting-staining): Heat-reflective, slip-resistant deck coatings.
- [Commercial Painting](https://www.paint-techs.com/commercial-painting): Interior and exterior painting for retail, office, and medical spaces.
- [All Services](https://www.paint-techs.com/services)
- [Residential Exterior Painting in Jacksonville](https://www.paint-techs.com/residential-exterior-painting-jacksonville): Real before-and-after photos, process breakdown, and $4,000-15,000 pricing.
- [Cabinet Refinishing Project in Nocatee](https://www.paint-techs.com/cabinet-refinishing-nocatee): Before-and-after case study of a full kitchen cabinet repaint.
